$comment: Agent Fighter's per-match server as a hashed artifact (node/server-bundle.js): npm run bundle:server -- gauntlets/agent-fighter.server.json [--root <checkout>] packs packages/server/src/gauntlet-server.ts with @af/core and ws inlined, plus the character, stage and pet JSON the server reads beside itself (the sprites stay out: the server never reads them), into servers/agent-fighter.v1.server.tgz and prints the serverHash. The publisher registers that hash under the title (npm run publish:title -- set-build servers/agent-fighter.v1.server.json) and serves it from its node (GAUNTLET_SERVERS=agent-fighter.v1=servers/agent-fighter.v1.server.tgz); an operator opts in with GAUNTLET_SERVERS=agent-fighter.v1 and needs no checkout. `root` is this machine's checkout; --root or AF_ROOT overrides it. The settings below go into the bundle's manifest: the gauntlet settings the node runs it with (node/gauntlet.js). This bundle is the only way an Agent Fighter match reaches the mesh; the always-on relay keeps its casual results in Agent Fighter's own database.
